title: Shorten the fixed frame506 matcher from 24 to 16 factors (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite factorization certificate and scoped tensor-lift proof, produced by Nick Petalas. The fixed eight-dimensional frame506 matcher of JoyboyBrian's PR4989 has a shorter literal column word and inverse:

```diff
- 5 swaps + 5 scalings + 14 additions = 24 factors
+ 5 swaps + 4 scalings +  7 additions = 16 factors
```

The full matrix is exactly the same `S8=[B^T|A^T]`. For `N=8f`, both directions of the complete addressed route remove `14Nf` ordered shifts and `2Nf` unit scalings, hence `128f^2` steps in either ROW branch. Earlier-target shifts stay at `64f^2`; later-target shifts fall from PR6291's cited `160f^2` to `48f^2`. The unresolved earlier-target transposition count does not grow. The first exact improvement is shipped; no optimality search follows it.

The new total counts are `13+6N^2+32Nf` in the fallback branch and `13+6N^2+122Nf` in the borrowed branch. The three source shapes yield 653, 1,373 and 5,453 steps. Source comparator counts are credited premises, not replays or audit deliverables. The word changes intermediate address pairs while preserving the full matcher and the owner/spectator contract.

Only `research/frame506-short-route/` is added. The BIT target/paid moment and selected frontier are unchanged. No new kappa or physical runtime saving is claimed.

## Evidence

- Exact rational multiplication checks every entry of the new word against the pinned source matrix and checks both inverse orders. A direct row calculation and tensor multiplication prove the lift for every positive `f`; coefficients and inverses lie in `Z[1/2]`.
- 936 complete modular rows compare literal factor execution and whole-route low/high carries with a separate dense source-matrix product, including inverse restoration. The fixed domain has `f=1,2,3`, `q=3,5,7,11`, `w=2,3,5`.
- Eight complete addressed ledgers cover both ROW branches at `f=1,2,3,8`. All 27 controls reject, including each omitted factor, seven wrong signs, reversed order, lost carry and wrong orientation. A generated receipt binds source and package hashes.
- All registered normal and optimized warning-strict checks pass locally on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.15. Each registered scientific command took under one second. Package metadata/pins, whitespace and committed-byte/source-history checks pass on head `8c7a406f60de96ef51af13ecf01ff4e4dce7fa35`; the publication check covers nine package/input files and the reachable canonical base.

From the repository root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter path, or substitute any CPython 3.12 interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/frame506-short-route/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/frame506-short-route/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/frame506-short-route
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/frame506-short-route --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: `PASS_FRAME506_SHORT_ROUTE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. No predecessor executable is imported or replayed.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This supplies a finite factorization certificate, a written all-positive-multiplicity lift and conditional scheduling counts. The ledger emitter is not a finite-alphabet runtime. Physical leaf acceptance of the changed intermediate order, coefficient preparation, address/head movement, native/ROW execution, cache retirement, P3/stock, precision/tape, compiler closure and all five selected framework assumptions retain their inherited obligations. Counts do not prove a complete physical tariff. Optimality, the selected cold replay, full predecessor suites, Lean, Docker, independent human review and formal proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Install the word into one actual current caller and price the changed coefficient/address sequence. Start with one completed unit-scale and ordered-shift interface, including movement and coefficient preparation. The physical integration and full tariff are the blocker; a wider factor search is not required for this contribution.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying the fixed helper462/frame506 elementary matcher factorization was found in the complete cached open-body corpus or the refreshed `frame506` and `4989` searches. The closest same-object work, PR4989, PR5052, PR5332, PR5487, PR5497 and PR6291, is merged and retains its separate schedule, physical-leaf, carry, commit and oracle-gap credit. PR1001 changes the frame506 scalar B block rather than this matcher; PR5782 concerns the G20 native maps. Search coverage excludes arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work.

## Credit

JoyboyBrian / PR4989 supplies the matrix, schedule, owner/ROW interface and published comparator; unpaidmoon / PR6291 supplies the directional comparator and physical gap. Credit ai-nanachi / PR4760 and PR4814, Clear1nsight / PR4957, rohanarun / PR185 and PR199, Maxime Fleury / PR204, Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Mark/Matarener and the retained native/E8/ordinary/routing/precision/tape lineage. Elementary elimination and sum/difference transforms are classical. The new result is the shorter fixed-matcher word, inverse and complete conditional scheduling consequence. Apache-2.0.
